:::{#def-closed-form-expression}
#### Closed-form expression (formula)

A **closed-form expression** (or **formula**)
[@wikipedia_closed_form_expression]
is an [expression](#def-expression) built from constants and variables <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
using a finite number of operations from a list of accepted [functions](functions.qmd#def-function), <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
such as [powers](algebra-basics.qmd#def-power), roots, exponentials, logarithms, and trigonometric functions.
Which functions are accepted is a convention,
and a source states it when the boundary matters.

:::
